Definition: a tumor; also a mound, i.e. fortress
BiblicalUsage: This word carries two meanings, and both are heavy. When the ark was taken, the hand of the Lord smote the people of Ashdod with tumours, and in Kings the word names the tower, the fortified mound, where Gehazi took the gifts from Naaman's servants.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two meanings belong together in a hard way: what God strikes down in judgment and what men build up for defence are both in His hands.
